title: Loan Servicing Waterfall Recompute
description: Independently recomputes how a single loan payment applies across escrow, fee, interest and principal buckets under the note's own declared application order, then diffs the recomputed breakdown against the core's actual applied amounts. The application order, bucket balances and payment amount are all caller-declared contract terms -- this tool never chooses or infers a posting order, and asserts no universal statutory application order. Reports MATCHES, DIVERGES (with per-bucket deltas), or INDETERMINATE whenever a required input is absent. Recompute and receipt only, never a claim of core-vendor endorsement or that either side's figure is legally correct.

application_order.description: Ordered, unique, non-empty list of bucket ids the note's own payment-application order declares

bucket_balances.description: Map of bucket id to pre-payment owed balance, integer minor units

payment_amount.description: The payment amount to allocate, integer minor units

core_applied.description: Optional: the core's actual applied breakdown to diff against

mcp_tool_definition.description: Recomputes a single loan payment's application across caller-declared buckets under the note's own bucket application order, and diffs the result against the core's actual applied breakdown.
